fusions.name: Drag Line
fusions.desc: A hooked pull that deals 12 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and hauls you up to 6 tiles to the target.

fusions.name: Leavings Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a wide cone ahead of you that deals 4 damage to everything caught in it, each hit with a 25% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Tidy Up
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Left Behind
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
